Question: ASSALAM O ALAIKUM Q: what r the rights of foster mother in islam? JAZAKALLAH REMEMBER ALL UMMAT IN UR DUAS ASSALAM O ALAIKUM Answer ID: 18719 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 99/99/M1431) Foster mother is just like real mother. We must respect her, help and serve her. Once Sayyidah Halimah Sadiyah (the foster mother of the Prophet صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) came to the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ), he spread out his chaddar for her and made her to sit on it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
